description: Look up one entry of the Solvency Census, a public ledger of AI agents that claim to pay for their own inference, judged net of inference cost. Input: entry name or number (fuzzy match, e.g. 'vega', '9', 'bankr'). Returns JSON with status (self-funding / agent-operated human-funded / unverifiable / not an agent), funding shape, meter type, unknowns, summary and receipt link. Unreadable numbers are reported as unknown, not zero. Paid: 0.01 USDC a call. First send it in USDC on Base to 0x67B3dd7FA57811A07d19898926F8C11adfdAe0D8, then call this within 30 minutes with the transaction hash as tx_hash. Each hash pays for one call.

entry.description: Entry name or ledger number, e.g. 'Kairence', '8', 'vegachiefofstaff'

name: census_lookup
